original_context: Every historical figure either influenced future generations or improved processes.

If Jefferson advanced knowledge, then he either gained recognition or influenced future generations (but not both).
Any historical figure who undertook rigorous research faced significant challenges.
Jefferson either pioneered innovation or faced significant challenges, but not both.
Jefferson either advanced knowledge or shaped an industry.
If a historical figure either pioneered innovation or shaped an industry (but not both), then they made a lasting impact.
Either Jefferson made a lasting impact or he left no legacy, but not both.
conclusion: Jefferson did not leave no legacy.
